tool.name: evaluate_target_ecgfeat_diagnosis.py
tool.gate_role: Guard the interpretation-distribution split and its compatibility adapter (doc 05 B: Phase 5).
tool.cadence: Every ecginterpret release and every core release that changes fields consumed by interpretation (doc 06).

datasets.name: PTB-XL
datasets.subset_rule: Deterministic subset: every record of the local PTB-XL shard 09000 (1000 records, 09000_hr..09999_hr, the tool's own sorted *.hea discovery, no --limit). The full 10-shard local copy (10000 records) is not run per release for runtime.

datasets.name: SNOMED-CT condition names
datasets.subset_rule: Condition-name CSV read by the tool.

record_schema_note: legacy ecgfeat export (pre-ECG-Record); no record schema is exercised by these tools at this revision

determinism.ungated_note: runtime/wall-clock values; environment-dependent, not gated, not a result difference
